name: Weighted Decline Sit-Up
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate decline, hook your feet securely under the leg pads, and hug a weight plate tightly against your chest.
Lower your back smoothly down along the declined bench while keeping your core braced tightly.
Contract your abs forcefully to curl your torso all the way up until you approach upright over your hips.
Unroll your torso slowly back down along the bench under full control without bouncing at the bottom.
tips: Keep your hips on the bench and guide your back onto the pad without a bounce.
Keep the plate pressed snugly against your chest rather than throwing it forward for momentum.
